patches.title: Skip Cooking Furniture
patches.principle: Avoid searching stoveburners, microwaves, or toasters for objects to clean.
patches.when_to_apply: When initial open surfaces lack the target for a clean task.

patches.title: Direct Sequence Completion
patches.principle: After picking up the object, go directly to the transformation station, then directly to the destination.
patches.when_to_apply: When holding an object that needs cleaning, heating, or cooling.

patches.title: Resume Surface Search
patches.principle: After opening a container and not finding the target, return to checking open surfaces before opening more containers.
patches.when_to_apply: When a container is opened and the target is not inside.
